conflicts.permit: The Personal Information that I collect is used for providing and improving the Service.
conflicts.prohibit: The information that I request is retained on your device and is not collected by me in any way
conflicts.situation: When a user provides personally identifiable information requested by the developer while using the service.
conflicts.reason: One sentence states that the developer collects personal information, while another explicitly states requested personally identifiable information is not collected by the developer in any way.
